doubts: This page describes several separate tracks in the Nevis Valley, so it is a network. The packet has no road-end features, so the Nevis Road starts and the conservation-area boundary ends have no ref; for River Face, Dark Elliots and Sunny Elliots the start is only implied as Nevis Road (presumably Nevis Crossing, where the Nevis-Gibbston Track begins, but the text does not say so). Where the River Face Track branches off the Nevis-Gibbston Track is not stated. All shapes are one_way from DOC's 'one way' times; the text does not say how walkers return. The Nevis-Gibbston and Ryders tracks have no map-track entry in the names, so they have no ref. The dogs note about Boundary Creek Track appears unrelated to this page's tracks.
